note: Six-layer J802 SimpleRouteJson board (byte-identical input to srj-j802-six-layer-v2). 15 declared connections; required-connection count is 15 (Q-68 ruling (b), rules/connectivity.md K-13..K-15). violations.maxAdded 0 is hard (R-1); violations.preExisting 0 is hard: the reference loads 0 violations because Prior copper is DRC-silent among itself (formats/srj.md J-33, rules/drc.md DR-13). Requires the context-net import reading (GND-owned pads cover endpoints, formats/srj.md J-25); those GND pads are Prior copper and are silent against other Prior copper, so a reading that spacing-checks Prior-vs-Prior over-reports before routing and fails this metric. incomplete is set to the reference's completion figure: the sealed reference joins 9 of 15 (incomplete 6) by attaching to Prior copper (formats/srj.md J-34, rules/connectivity.md K-16). It is advisory (reachable-with-attachment): until the router can attach to Prior copper, incomplete-after stays at 15. Reference numbers: spec/acceptance/reference/b223-j802-six-layer-v3.srj.default.json. Under a generous budget (up to 500 passes / 300 s / 30 stagnant passes, S9) the reference still joins 9 of 15 (incomplete 6) in about 52 s, so the advisory bound of 6 is unchanged; generous-budget numbers: spec/acceptance/reference/b223-j802-six-layer-v3.srj.bound.json.
